items.note: Compares GPT-3 Alternative Uses Test responses with previously collected human responses on expert-rated originality, usefulness, surprise, flexibility, and semantic distance; no participant uses AI.
Benchmarks several LLMs against individual humans and human groups on 13 creative tasks in three domains; no participant uses AI, and the abstract gives no human sample size.

Meme-creation user study with human-only and human-LLM groups of 50 participants each (plus an AI-only arm, so 100 people across the two human arms), memes crowd-rated on creativity, humor, and shareability; assignment method not stated in the abstract.
Compares GPT-3.5/GPT-4/GPT-4o with humans on divergent and convergent thinking, insight, creative writing, association, and creative evaluation tasks; no participant uses AI.

Randomized online experiment comparing ChatGPT with Google Search as aids for generating new product ideas, with idea novelty, diversity, and functional appropriateness scored; abstract from Crossref (OpenAlex and Semantic Scholar had none), sample size not stated.
